class.name: EntityEnumProperty
class.brief_description: Integer choice property for a map entity.
class.description: Add this resource to [member EntityDefinition.enum_properties] to expose an integer dropdown in the generated TrenchBroom FGD. This is authoring metadata; it does not apply values to scene nodes. The exporter validates keys, choices, and defaults before replacing generated files.

members.member: Stable map property key. Use letters, digits, and underscores. Keys must be unique within an entity, ignoring case. The keys classname, origin, angle, angles, and spawnflags are reserved.
Name displayed in the map editor. Empty uses [member key].
Help text displayed in the map editor.
Default integer value. Must match one of the choices.
Display labels mapped to integer values, in display order. Labels must be nonempty and values unique. Returned dictionaries are copies; assign the dictionary back after editing.
